# My Gadgets Whitton
# Independent computer repair shop and refurbished MacBook store.

Name: My Gadgets Whitton
Legal name: MY GADGETS LTD
Address: 23 High Street, Whitton, Twickenham TW2 7LB, United Kingdom
Hours: Monday–Friday 09:00–18:00; Saturday 10:30–17:00; Sunday closed
Landline: 020 8847 4747
Mobile and WhatsApp: 07918 440326
Email: contact@mygadgets.uk
Website: https://www.mygadgets.uk

My Gadgets Whitton repairs MacBooks, Windows laptops, desktop PCs, PlayStation and Xbox consoles. Diagnosis is free. We give a written quote before work starts. If we cannot fix it, you pay nothing. Repairs have a written 3-month warranty. Refurbished MacBooks have a 6-month warranty and can be inspected in the shop before payment.

Priority services:
- MacBook repair, including screen replacement (from £129; many in 2–4 hours), battery replacement (from £89), keyboard, logic board, liquid damage, data recovery and SSD upgrades
- Windows laptop screen replacement (from £79) and SSD upgrades
- Data recovery from MacBooks and laptops; no data, no fee; from £129
- PS5 and Xbox HDMI port repair: £70 when the socket is the fault
- PS5 HDMI port repair by post from anywhere in the UK, repaired the same day it arrives, free return postage: https://www.mygadgets.uk/repairs/playstation/hdmi-port-repair/
- Xbox and PS4 repairs are shop visits only
- Refurbished MacBook Air, MacBook Pro and iMac: https://www.mygadgets.uk/shop/

We serve customers in Whitton, Twickenham, Hounslow, Isleworth, Feltham, Teddington, Richmond, St Margarets, Hanworth, Bedfont and Heston. Walk-ins are welcome. There is one workshop, at the Whitton address above. We do not have a second shop.
